ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence that screens the corporate shareholder, all directors, the Vietnamese legal representative, authorized signatories, and every natural-person UBO at the 25% threshold against (i) the PEP database of the Anti-Money Laundering Information Center under the State Bank of Viet Nam, (ii) Viet Nam's consolidated UN Security Council sanctions and domestic counter-terrorism financing lists, (iii) the OFAC SDN and Non-SDN lists adopted as cross-border best practice, (iv) international sanctions enforcement lists of the EU, UK, and Singapore, and (v) adverse-media/world-check class databases. Screening must be repeated at each change of control, each re-registration of the legal representative, and at least annually, and the results must be documented in the captive's AML/CFT compliance manual before the business license is granted.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) — https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, operating together with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment e-filing system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory enterprise name must be composed in the Vietnamese language using the Vietnamese alphabet (Quốc ngữ) with optional Arabic numerals and permissible symbols; foreign-invested enterprises may add a short equivalent name in a foreign language, but the dominant statutory name must be in Vietnamese. The name must contain 'Công ty TNHH' ('Limited Liability Company') and must comply with Articles 37-42 of Law No. 59/2020/QH14 and Articles 16-25 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, including the rule of non-identical and non-confusingly-similar naming against the national database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Where the Department of Planning and Investment rejects a proposed name, the applicant may (1) re-submit a revised enterprise-registration dossier with an alternative name on the National Enterprise Registration Portal within 30 days without penalty; (2) file a written reconsideration request to the Director of the provincial DPI within 15 working days from the refusal notice; (3) lodge a formal administrative complaint under Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 and Decree No. 124/2020/ND-CP to the Director of the DPI or the provincial People's Committee within 30 days, appealable within 30 days of the complaint decision to the Ministry of Planning and Investment; and (4) initiate administrative court proceedings under Law No. 93/2015/QH13. For insurance-sector names containing 'Insurance' or 'Reinsurance', the applicant must first obtain a written name and establishment approval-in-principle from the Ministry of Finance (valid 12 months under Decree No. 46/2023/ND-CP); a DPI refusal on that ground is cured by attaching the Ministerial approval to the re-filed dossier.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for the captive reinsurance SPV. A licensed reinsurance enterprise must maintain a physical head office in Viet Nam evidenced by title, a lawful lease of at least the licence duration, locally managed operations, and Vietnamese-resident compliance personnel; the Ministry of Finance routinely checks the registered-office address in licensing and on-site inspections and does not accept virtual offices or co-working addresses for licensed financial institutions.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — quantified risk of approximately 75% within the first 24 months of licensing: the Insurance Supervisory Authority of the Ministry of Finance conducts licensing-condition inspections, and the State Bank of Viet Nam may carry out unannounced AML/CFT supervisory visits under its annual on-site examination program. Additional inspections by the provincial DPI are possible in respect of registered-office compliance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Circular No. 47/2019/TT-BTC on enterprise-registration fees

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 of 17 June 2020 (Articles 24-25 on incorporation procedure, Articles 30-36 on capital contribution, Articles 46-61 on the Members' Council and governance of a multi-member limited liability company, and Articles 195-199 on the legal representative); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 29-38 on investment registration and investment certificates for foreign-invested projects); Decree No. 47/2021/ND-CP of 1 April 2021 on enterprise registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP and its Appendix IV item 42 listing insurance and reinsurance as conditional market-access sectors under Vietnam's WTO schedule (WTOCAT42); Law on Insurance Business No. 08/2022/QH15 of 16 June 2022 (Articles 63-75 on establishment licensing of insurers/reinsurers); and Decree No. 46/2023/ND-CP of 11 July 2023 on detailed implementation of the Law on Insurance Business, including Article 6 (legal capital) and Article 5 (qualifications of managers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) and Investment Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký đầu tư) of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (Sở Kế hoạch và Đầu tư) of the province where the registered office is located; nationwide electronic filing is conducted via the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) – Form A-IV-1 annexed to Decree No. 47/2021/ND-CP, accompanied by the Investment Registration Application (Form A-1) under the Law on Investment 2020 and the Insurance Establishment License application (Giấy đề nghị cấp Giấy phép thành lập và hoạt động kinh doanh bảo hiểm) under Law on Insurance Business 2022.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No general statutory minimum charter capital applies to limited liability companies under the Law on Enterprises 2020; however, because the captive reinsurance SPV is an insurance-business enterprise, Decree No. 46/2023/ND-CP Article 6 sets a legal capital floor of VND 300,000,000,000 (approximately USD 12.7 million at prevailing exchange rates) for a reinsurance enterprise. The charter capital must equal or exceed this legal capital. The full charter capital must be irrevocably deposited into a blocked escrow account (tài khoản phong tỏa) at a licensed commercial bank operating in Vietnam prior to submission of the Insurance Establishment License dossier; the bank's balance-freeze certificate is attached to the dossier, and the escrowed funds are released for licensed operational use only after the Ministry of Finance issues the Insurance Establishment License.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE MEMBERS' COUNCIL OF [●] CO., LTD. (Company code [●]) – adopted by unanimous written consent of all members on [date], in accordance with Article 46 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Article 19 of the Company's Charter. WHEREAS the Company is a foreign-invested limited liability company formed under the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam for the purpose of operating a captive reinsurance SPV (ISIC 6512); NOW THEREFORE IT IS RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS: 1. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office of the Company is fixed at [full address], [province/centrally-run city], Vietnam; the Chairman is authorized to execute the registered office lease or use-confirmation documents and to file the incorporation dossier at the Business Registration Office. 2. CHARTER CAPITAL: The charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [●] ([in words]) equal to or exceeding the legal capital of VND 300,000,000,000 required for reinsurance operations; the capital is subscribed and allocated among the founding members as set forth in the attached capital contribution schedule; the Members' Council ratifies the capital schedule and the commitment from each member to contribute in full within 90 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. 3. ESCROW ARRANGEMENT: The Members' Council approves the opening of a blocked escrow account at [bank name and branch] and directs the General Director to deposit the full charter capital therein, to obtain the bank's balance-freeze certificate, and to maintain the escrow until the Ministry of Finance issues the Insurance Establishment License. 4. CHARTER ADOPTION: The Members' Council unanimously adopts the Company's Charter (Điều lệ công ty) as submitted, and authorizes the Chairman and General Director to sign all registration forms and to lodge the Charter with the Business Registration Office. 5. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: [Name, passport/ID No.] is appointed Chairman of the Members' Council and legal representative of the Company with the authority to sign the enterprise registration dossier, the Investment Registration Certificate application, and the Insurance Establishment License application; [Name, passport/ID No.] is appointed General Director (Chief Executive Officer) with day-to-day management powers and authorization to open bank accounts, execute escrow documents, and hire professional advisers; [Name, ID No.] is appointed Chief Accountant responsible for statutory accounting and tax filings. 6. INVESTMENT REGISTRATION: The Members' Council approves the captive reinsurance investment project and authorizes the Chairman to execute the Investment Registration Certificate application (Form A-1) required for foreign-invested projects under the Law on Investment 2020. 7. MARKET-ACCESS CONDITIONS: The Members' Council acknowledges that the Company's reinsurance activity is a conditional business line under WTO commitment WTOCAT42 and Decree 31/2021/ND-CP, and authorizes the General Director to prepare and submit all documents evidencing the Company's compliance with the foreign-investment and insurance licensing conditions of the Ministry of Finance. 8. IMPLEMENTATION: The Chairman and General Director are jointly and severally authorized to take all further actions, to sign all instruments, and to pay all fees necessary to consummate the incorporation, licensing, and physical-operational clearance of the Company. This Resolution is effective immediately and remains in force until amended or revoked by a subsequent resolution of the Members' Council.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for the Foreign-Invested Captive Reinsurance Project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Office of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) where the registered office is located; electronic submission accepted through the National Foreign Investment Portal under Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and notarize all corporate and personal identification documents of the foreign founding member(s) at a legally recognized notary office or through consular legalization in the country of origin. Submit the investment registration dossier (Form A-1 for an investment project of a foreign investor) together with a market-access declaration confirming that the captive reinsurance SPV is classified under ISIC 6512 and complies with the conditions of WTO schedule WTOCAT42 (reinsurance is permitted as a 100% foreign-owned enterprise with the condition that the insurer obtains the Ministry of Finance's establishment license). The DPI will consult the Ministry of Finance where necessary to verify the licensability of the project in the insurance sector. Where the project requires an investment policy decision, the provincial People's Committee shall issue the policy decision before the IRC is granted. If the DPI requires clarification on the charter capital, the parent's audited financial statements, or the captive parent's credit risk, provide a written response within the statutory period. Upon issuance of the IRC, the project legalizes the foreign investment and triggers the obligation to obtain an Enterprise Registration Certificate within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Investment registration application (Form A-1)
Foreign investor's legal existence documents certified in the home jurisdiction (certificate of incorporation, charter, and good-standing certificate)
Report on the financial capacity of the foreign investor (Form A-II-1) supported by audited financial statements for the most recent two fiscal years or parent company guarantee
Statement of compliance with market-access conditions for reinsurance under WTOCAT42
Captive captive-parent structure chart and explanation of the intra-group reinsurance risk underwriting program
Proof of charter capital source and a commitment letter for the blocked escrow deposit of VND 300 billion
Lease agreement or headquarters location confirmation letter for the proposed registered office in Vietnam
Power of attorney where a third party files the dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written request for amendment or additional documents, the applicant has 30 days to cure the deficiency; a re-submission does not extend the statutory 15-day evaluation window unless the project requires a policy decision. If the IRC is refused, the investor may file an administrative complaint with the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee within 90 days under the Law on Administrative Procedures, or may re-file a rectified dossier; alternatively, the investor may seek a written market-access opinion from the Ministry of Finance authorizing the captive reinsurance scope and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and Issuance of Enterprise Code
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI); online filing via the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the IRC, prepare and submit the enterprise registration dossier within 30 days. Complete Form A-IV-1 (Application for Enterprise Registration), attach the Company's Charter approved by the founding members, the list of members with capital contribution amounts, the list of legal representatives with notarized identity documents, the IRC, and a certified copy of the registered office lease. Pay the statutory fee of VND 100,000 (approx. USD 4) by electronic transfer or at the counter. The Business Registration Office validates the Company name against the enterprise name database, confirms the scope of business includes 'reinsurance and captive reinsurance underwriting for affiliated enterprises' (ISIC 6512), verifies the legal representative's appointments, and issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký doanh nghiệp) together with the electronic enterprise code. The tax code is issued simultaneously with the ERC. The entity comes into legal existence as of the date of the ERC.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration – Form A-IV-1
Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) executed by all founding members
List of members and capital contribution allocation (Form A-IV-4)
List of legal representatives of the Company (Form A-IV-5)
Certified copy of the Investment Registration Certificate
Notarized copies of passports/ID cards of the Chairman, General Director, and Chief Accountant
Certified copy of the registered office lease agreement or documents proving legal use of the registered address
Seal specimen declaration form (to be filed later with the DPI after the seal is made)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is incomplete or invalid, the Business Registration Office issues a written notice requiring correction; the applicant must rectify and resubmit within 15 working days. If the ERC is denied, the applicant may appeal to the Director of the DPI under the Administrative Procedure Law 2015 within 90 days, or institute an administrative lawsuit at the competent People's Court; a pragmatic cure is to re-file immediately after curing the clerical defect (e.g., correcting the Company name or legal representative inventor).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Ministry of Finance Approval – Insurance Establishment License for the Captive Reinsurer
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Insurance Supervisory Authority (Cục Quản lý, giám sát bảo hiểm), Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, 58 Phố Huế, Hai Bà Trưng, Hanoi
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following the ERC, deposit the full charter capital (at least VND 300 billion) into a blocked escrow account at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank and obtain the balance-freeze certificate. Assemble the licensing dossier under Article 64 of the Law on Insurance Business 2022 and Article 30 of Decree 46/2023/ND-CP. The dossier must include: a written application for the Insurance Establishment License, the ERC, the Company Charter and the Memorandum of Understanding among the members, the business plan for the captive reinsurance SPV covering the risk programs to be written on behalf of the foreign parent/affiliated companies, the five-year financial projections with solvency margins, the escrow certificate for the charter capital, organizational chart and management biographies (the General Director must hold a university degree and at least five years of relevant experience in finance, insurance, or reinsurance per Article 5 of Decree 46/2023/ND-CP), documents proving that systems and internal control procedures comply with risk management and actuarial standards under Circular 03/2023/TT-BTC, and the corporate governance charter. Submit in hard copy to the Ministry of Finance counter or through the current official licensing submission channel. The Ministry of Finance reviews the dossier and may request supplemental opinions from the State Bank of Vietnam and the relevant provincial People's Committee. Within 60 calendar days of receipt of a complete and valid dossier, the Ministry issues the license or a written refusal. Upon issuance, the Company becomes a licensed insurance/reinsurance entity and may commence underwriting only after registration in the insurance business registration database.
required_dossiers: Application form for the Insurance Establishment and Operation License (Form prescribed by Circular 03/2023/TT-BTC)
Enterprise Registration Certificate of the company
Company Charter and shareholders'/members' resolutions approving the insurance business plan
Bank balance-freeze certificate evidencing deposit of the VND 300 billion charter capital in a blocked escrow account
Five-year business plan for the captive reinsurance SPV including risk programs, underwriting policy, and gross/net retention levels
Three-year financial projections, solvency capital requirement calculations, and reinsurance ceding/retrocession plan
Organizational structure plan, compliance manual, internal control and risk management policies
Curriculum vitae, degrees, and certificates of the Chairman, General Director, Chief Actuary, and Chief Compliance Officer
List of proposed underwriters and service providers (actuarial, legal, and auditor)
Certified English/Vietnamese translations of all foreign documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry of Finance refuses the license, it must provide written reasons. The applicant may submit a revised dossier curing the deficiencies no earlier than 30 days from the refusal, or may file an administrative complaint with the Minister of Finance within 90 days of the refusal date under the Administrative Procedure Law 2015. In a constructive practice, the applicant may request a pre-consultation conference with the Insurance Supervisory Authority to align the captive plan with regulatory expectations before re-filing; if the refusal concerns capital adequacy, the applicant may increase the charter capital and escrow the supplementary amount and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Licensing Corporate Mechanics: Corporate Seal, Tax Registration, Social Insurance, Operating Bank Account, and Escrow Release
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (seal specimen); General Department of Taxation, branch tax office of the registered province (tax-registration updates); Social Insurance Agency of the province (labour registration); and the licensed commercial bank holding the escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 10 working days of the ERC, order a statutory corporate seal from a licensed seal-making enterprise and immediately notify the seal specimen to the Business Registration Office on the National Business Registration Portal; the seal will be classified in the national corporate seal database. Confirm that the tax code identity (MST) issued with the ERC is active and file the initial tax registration declarations (including the so-called 'license tax' declaration for the first-year business license fee under Decree 139/2016/ND-CP as amended). Register all employees with the provincial Social Insurance Agency for social, health, and unemployment insurance within 30 days of the first employment contract. Once the Insurance Establishment License is issued, present the license to the escrow bank to release the blocked charter capital into the company's operating account, and open a segregated underwriting account with a licensed commercial bank for the receipt of reinsurance premiums and the maintenance of technical reserves. Appoint a statutory independent audit firm meeting the Ministry of Finance's requirements for insurance enterprises. Register any captive reinsurance programs and policy documents with the Insurance Supervisory Authority as required by Circular 03/2023/TT-BTC.
required_dossiers: Corporate seal purchase invoice and seal specimen notification form
Enterprise Registration Certificate and Insurance Establishment License (certified copies)
Tax registration application (Form DK01-THĐKT) and license-tax declaration (Form CK-01)
Escrow release order countersigned by the General Director and Chairman
Operating bank account opening application and specimen signatures
Employee labor contracts and social insurance registration forms
Appointment letter of the statutory auditor and audit engagement agreement
Captive reinsurance program registration form for submission to the Insurance Supervisory Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office has not issued the tax code, the company should first verify that the enterprise code and tax code are one and the same and, if not, apply for a separate tax code at the provincial tax office with a written explanation. If the seal specimen notification is rejected by the DPI due to a naming or format issue, re-submit with corrected seal characters within 5 working days. If the escrow bank refuses to release the escrow absent an official MoF acknowledgement letter, obtain the written acknowledgement from the Insurance Supervisory Authority confirming the license's effective date and the capital-release authorization, and, if necessary, escalate to the State Bank of Vietnam's banking supervision branch.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Physical, Fire Safety, Environmental, and Occupational Clearance for the Operating Premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department of the provincial Police (Cảnh sát PCCC và CNCH); Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) or the commune-level People's Committee for environmental registration; provincial construction inspectorate for structural clearance; and the Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA) for occupational safety
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prior to occupying the registered office premises, obtain fire safety design appraisal and acceptance certification for the office facility in accordance with the Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting 2001 (as amended in 2013), Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP, and Circular No. 83/2017/TT-BCA. Submit to the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police the office floor plans, electrical single-line diagrams, fire alarm and evacuation system designs, and the fire-fighting equipment list; after inspection on site, obtain the Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate. If the office is located in an industrial park, export processing zone, or economic zone, obtain the environmental registration (Đăng ký môi trường) from the DONRE under Article 42 of the Law on Environmental Protection 2020; if the office is in a purely commercial building with no hazardous waste generation, an environmental registration to the commune-level People's Committee or no EIA is sufficient. Where standby emergency generators or boilers are installed, submit an air-emission source registration and demonstrate compliance with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT. Arrange a structural load confirmation/use-change approval from the district construction inspectorate if the building was originally approved for a different occupancy class, and obtain an occupational health and safety baseline risk assessment certificate under Decree 39/2016/ND-CP and the Law on Occupational Safety and Health 2015.
required_dossiers: Fire safety design plan and appraisal application to the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police
Fire safety equipment list with technical specifications and installation certificates
Office building lease agreement and the building owner's fire-safety certificate
Environmental registration dossier (environmental commitment plan, waste generation estimate, waste-handling contracts with licensed transporters)

Application for air-emission registration if an emergency generator/boiler is installed, including stack emission test report against QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT and QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for any wastewater discharge
Structural inspection certificate or use-change approval from the construction inspectorate
Occupational risk assessment report and the five-step labor safety inspection checklist signed by a competent labor safety officer
Workplace environmental monitoring report (lighting, noise, microclimate, dust) per QCVN 05:2023/BTNMT and the Ministry of Health circulars
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police issue a written deficiency notice, cure the fire-safety rectification report and re-submit the updated design dossier within 20 working days; the department must provide a second inspection within 15 days. If the environmental registration is objected to because the premises fall within a sensitive protection zone, upgrade to a formal EIA under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP or relocate the office to a compliant business address. If the construction inspectorate denies structural clearance, obtain a retroactive strengthening design from a Vietnamese registered engineer or select alternative premises, then re-file the clearance under the Construction Law 2014. For DOLISA objections, rectify the workplace risk assessment and re-submit within 30 days; failure to obtain the occupational clearance could trigger an administrative suspension, so the applicant should secure an independent OHS audit and address non-conformities as an adverse-action cure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Insurance Supervisory Authority (Cục Quản lý, giám sát bảo hiểm), Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Bộ Tài chính)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Insurance Establishment and Operation License (Giấy phép thành lập và hoạt động trong lĩnh vực kinh doanh bảo hiểm) issued pursuant to the Law on Insurance Business No. 08/2022/QH15 and Decree No. 46/2023/ND-CP

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vietnam Environment Administration (Tổng cục Môi trường) within the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (Bộ Tài nguyên và Môi trường); provincial-level Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environmental registration dossiers
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment. A captive reinsurance SPV is a non-manufacturing, office-based enterprise that is not included in the mandatory EIA list of the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH13 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP. It is subject only to the simplified Environmental Registration (Đăng ký môi trường) regime if hazardous-waste-generating equipment is present; a purely administrative office with normal domestically generated waste is generally eligible for registration at the commune-level People's Committee or, in the case of offices within an industrial park, registration with the park's environmental management unit.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: if domestic wastewater is discharged into a municipal sewer, the acceptance standards of the sewer operator apply; if discharged to a receiving surface water body, compliance with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT (domestic wastewater) table B is required. Process/emergency generator exhaust emissions: compliance with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT for industrial emissions (dust, CO, SO2, NOx, VOC) where a standby diesel generator or boiler is installed; if no combustion source exists, this standard does not apply. Hazardous waste: the enterprise must comply with Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP on waste management, executing a hazardous-waste contractual agreement with a licensed transporter and treatment company and submitting a notification under the e-waste management portal if monthly hazardous waste exceeds 600 kg. Indoor air quality and work environment comfort for office workers: QCVN 05:2023/BTNMT (ambient air) and QCVN 21:2016/BYT (occupational hygiene) apply to lighting, microclimate, noise, and airborne particles. Noise/vibration in neighboring residential areas: QCVN 26:2010/BTNMT and QCVN 27:2010/BTNMT apply. All environmental compliance documentation must be maintained on-site for the five-year statutory retention period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Design Appraisal and Fire Fighting Acceptance (thẩm duyệt thiết kế phòng cháy chữa cháy và nghiệm thu) issued by the provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP and the Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting; the enterprise must obtain a fire-safety certificate for the premises, install an approved fire alarm and suppression system, maintain a fire-response plan, and appoint a fire brigade for the workplace. Structural clearance and safe-building-use confirmation from the local construction inspectorate under the Construction Law No. 50/2014/QH13 (as amended) confirming the building's structural load capacity for the intended office/data-center occupancy. Occupational safety and health clearance under the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13 and Decree No. 39/2016/ND-CP, including a baseline risk assessment, workplace environment monitoring, periodic health checkups for employees, and a certification that the premises comply with labor safety standards; additionally, a civil-defense preparedness check confirming the office has emergency evacuation routes, a shelter plan, and a first-aid station in accordance with Decree No. 03/2019/ND-CP (civil defense law) is recommended, given the enterprise's designation as a financial market infrastructure participant.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế, GDT) under the Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. Primary e-tax portal: https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn (e-filing, e-invoicing, taxpayer account management) and https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (legacy electronic tax portal). Import/export tariff and customs clearance are administered by the General Department of Vietnam Customs (Tổng cục Hải quan) at https://www.customs.gov.vn. The insurance and reinsurance licensing authority is the Ministry of Finance (Insurance Supervisory Authority).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the foreign-invested LLC captive reinsurer: (1) obtain an Insurance Enterprise Establishment and Operation License from the Ministry of Finance, which is a statutory precondition for any captive reinsurance entity under the Law on Insurance Business 2022 (08/2022/QH15), including satisfying minimum charter capital, governance, and solvency capital requirements; (2) after the insurance license is granted, file the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) application with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI); (3) the General Department of Taxation automatically issues the 10-digit Tax Identification Number (Mã số thuế) concurrently with ERC issuance under the integrated business and tax registration mechanism (Decree No. 122/2021/ND-CP), so no separate initial TIN application is required for locally incorporated entities; (4) activate the GDT e-tax account on etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn, elect CIT/ VAT finalization cycles, and complete e-invoice registration with tax-authority codes under Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP; (5) register the foreign currency account and export/import FX payment codes with an authorized bank, and notify the State Bank of Vietnam as needed for cross-border premium and reserve remittances; and (6) complete payroll, social insurance, unemployment, and health insurance registration with the provincial social insurance agency. A foreign corporate that operates without a permanent establishment in Viet Nam does not obtain a domestic TIN through this route but instead registers with the GDT for Foreign Contractor Withholding Tax (FCT) and receives a temporary tax code.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the LLC is a Vietnamese tax resident enterprise subject to Corporate Income Tax at the standard 20% rate on worldwide income under the Law on Enterprise Income Tax (14/2008/QH13, as amended); no pass-through or transparent treatment is available to limited liability companies; dividends and distributions are not deductible; the captive's premium income, investment income, and gains are taxable at the entity level. Territorial_Scope: non-resident insurers and reinsurers are taxed only on Vietnam-source income through FCT or withholding tax, but a locally licensed captive is a resident taxpayer. Tax_Exempt_Zone: not available; export processing enterprise (EPE) zero-VAT and customs-duty incentives do not apply to a financial-services captive, and no special economic-zone VAT/CIT exemption is available for captive reinsurance in Viet Nam.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam has no check-the-box or partnership classification election; all LLCs and JSCs are mandatorily entity-level CIT taxpayers. Available statutory elections and mitigation mechanisms: (a) CIT incentive election for qualifying new investment projects in eligible sectors or disadvantaged regions under Decree No. 218/2013/ND-CP (e.g., 10% preferential rate for up to 15 years, 4-year full exemption, 9-year 50% reduction), available only if the captive substantively satisfies the incentive conditions; (b) election of the foreign tax credit method to offset taxes paid on foreign-source insurance/reinsurance income against Vietnamese CIT (default is credit, not deduction); (c) thin-capitalization election to operate within the 30% EBITDA related-party interest cap under Decree No. 132/2020/ND-CP, which is a mandatory fixed-ratio rule rather than an elective safe harbor; (d) transfer-pricing elections: bilateral/unilateral Advance Pricing Agreements, and MAP invocation under Decree No. 126/2020/ND-CP where the BEPS MLI applies; (e) no hybrid mismatch election exists under Vietnamese domestic law; the Law on Tax Administration and Decree No. 132/2020/ND-CP recharacterize hybrid entities and instruments statutorily, and CFC rules must be assessed for any offshore captive affiliate.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Law on VAT No. 13/2008/QH12 as amended (31/2013/QH13 and 106/2016/QH13), implemented by Circular No. 219/2013/TT-BTC and amended by Circular No. 119/2014/TT-BTC; e-invoicing under Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP. The standard headline rate is 10%; a temporary 8% VAT reduction applies to most goods and services (excluding the Annex III sectors such as telecommunications, financial services, tourism, and insurance), extended by successive decrees through 2025. Critically, reinsurance services (tái bảo hiểm) are statutorily exempt from VAT under the exempt-supply list in Article 9 of Circular No. 219/2013/TT-BTC; the captive's gross reinsurance premium income therefore carries no output VAT and the corresponding input VAT is non-creditable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No minimum turnover threshold applies to incorporated taxpayers: every enterprise is automatically VAT-registered upon issuance of its Tax Identification Number, and VAT liability arises on any taxable supply in Viet Nam without de minimis exception. The only statutory threshold is for business households and private individuals with annual taxable revenue equal to or below VND 100,000,000, which are not required to register or charge VAT (Article 5.24 of the VAT Law); companies, including the LLC captive reinsurer, cannot invoke this exemption. A captive issuing taxable auxiliary services (e.g., management, underwriting support to affiliates) must charge 10% VAT on those supplies from the first dong of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing applies 100% from 1 July 2022 under Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP. Insurers and reinsurers must issue e-invoices with tax-authority codes (hóa đơn điện tử có mã của cơ quan thuế): the invoice is sent through an approved e-invoice intermediary to the GDT etaxvn platform via API; the GDT assigns a digital code in near-real-time and returns the digitally stamped invoice to the issuer, constituting fiscal clearance. Every e-invoice must contain a QR code and the GDT-defined JSON/XML schema. The taxpayer must transmit invoice data and summary ledgers to the GDT on a periodic basis and include them in CIT/VAT finalization. Exempt reinsurance premium income must still be documented on coded e-invoices stating the VAT-exempt basis; input VAT recovery is evidenced exclusively through matching e-invoices and non-cash payment records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT) is available only for genuinely exported goods and services meeting the conditions of Article 9 of the VAT Law and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC: (i) the service is supplied to a foreign entity under a written contract; (ii) the service is consumed entirely outside Viet Nam; (iii) payment is received from abroad; and (iv) the export settlement is made through an authorized bank. A Vietnamese captive reinsurer that assumes risk from a foreign-related captive would, in principle, be performing a service consumed outside Viet Nam; however, reinsurance itself is already VAT-exempt under the insurance exempt-supply list, and exempt services cannot be zero-rated, so the premium income enters neither the 10% nor the 0% VAT base and the associated input VAT is irrecoverable. 0% VAT treatment is claimable only for a genuine and severable export business line (e.g., fee-based actuarial or underwriting consultancy supplied to a foreign affiliate), which would require the full substantiation bundle. VAT refund of excess input credits is granted only for purchases attributable to taxable zero-rated or 10% export sales, and the refund claim (under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC) requires the exporter to have bank evidence of foreign payment within 90 days of the refund application and to have submitted e-invoice data with prior tax compliance confirmed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Vietnam Export Customs Declaration (Tờ khai hải quan hàng hóa xuất khẩu) with customs clearance status; for goods, the declaration must be matched with the physical exit record; for services, a non-customs declaration protocol applies and the service contract substitutes for the customs form
Signed reinsurance contract/cover note between the Vietnamese captive LLC and the foreign captive or ceding insurer, evidencing assumption of risk located outside Vietnam
Commercial invoice or reinsurance statement of account (Phiếu tính phí / Đề nghị thanh toán) issued by the Vietnamese captive
Reinsurance policy schedule, underwriting documentation, and actuarial or claims reserve report evidencing that the insured risk and loss events are situated outside Vietnam
Inward Remittance Certificate (Giấy báo Có) or bank Swift message confirming the premium remittance is credited to the captive's foreign-currency or VND account at an authorized bank in Vietnam
Foreign insurer/captive certificate of incorporation and, where relevant, tax residence certificate of the offshore recipient
Board resolution approving the captive reinsurance arrangement and transfer-pricing documentation substantiating an arm's-length premium
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT applies statistical profiling to VAT refund/zero-rating files, with captive reinsurers subject to heightened tax-risk review because premium flows move between related parties across borders and the service is intangible. Substantial penalties apply: wrongfully claimed refunds or zero-rating are clawed back in full together with late-payment interest at 0.03% per day (approximately 10.95% per annum) under the Law on Tax Administration (38/2019/QH14); administrative fines for tax evasion range from one to three times the evaded tax amount under Decree No. 125/2020/ND-CP; criminal liability attaches under Article 200 of the Penal Code (15/2017/QH14) where evaded VAT exceeds VND 100,000,000, with fines up to VND 4.5 billion, imprisonment of up to 20 years for the most aggravated bracket, and direct exposure of the legal representative, chief accountant, and external tax preparer; retrospective assessments may reach back ten years for fraudulent, concealed, or unregistered transactions; the tax authority may also apply 'red-list' customs debt suspension, freeze VAT refunds, publish non-compliance rankings, and impose additional penalties on the e-invoice intermediary. In addition, failure to repatriate export service proceeds within the 180-day foreign-exchange deadline violates State Bank of Vietnam regulations (Ordinance on Foreign Exchange 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11; Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN, as amended), exposing the entity to administrative fines, forced conversion of foreign currency, and suspension of tax refund processing until repatriation is completed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) – Foreign Exchange Control Department (FXCD)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam maintains current-account convertibility for permitted trade and services transactions while subjecting capital-account flows to registration, licensing, and the use of designated accounts. A captive reinsurance SPV under ISIC 6512 is treated as a service exporter for premium income received from overseas cedants; repatriated reinsurance premiums must be credited to a foreign-currency account at an SBV-licensed credit institution. Profit remittance hurdles include: (i) completion of audited annual financial statements prepared under Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) or IFRS as adopted for foreign-invested enterprises; (ii) corporate income tax finalization and production of the tax settlement certificate or tax clearance confirmation; (iii) submission of a foreign-currency withdrawal application to the licensed bank evidencing post-tax retained earnings; and (iv) compliance with the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), and the solvency-reserve and capital-maintenance requirements applicable to insurance and reinsurance activities under the Law on Insurance Business 2022 and Decree 73/2016/ND-CP. Dividends and profit transfers are permissible only after the annual financial statements have been approved and the statutory audit is completed; the captive SPV must maintain an actuary-certified technical reserve position and, where applicable, a security/collateral deposit for the benefit of overseas cedants.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange Control (No. 05/2005/PL-UBTVQH11, as amended) and SBV Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN, all export earnings—including cross-border reinsurance premium receipts—must be remitted into a foreign-currency account held at an SBV-licensed credit institution. The statutory surrender rule requires the mandatory sale to the licensed bank of 80% of the export foreign-exchange receipts (net of eligible deductions) as promptly as possible upon credit to the account; the remaining 20% may be retained in the foreign-currency account for working-capital and permitted trade purposes. Any exemption, deferral, or reduced surrender ratio must be approved in advance by the State Bank of Vietnam. Reinsurance claims, loss-adjustment expenses, and reserve releases payable to overseas cedants are remitted through the same licensed bank with underlying reinsurance treaty contracts, bordereaux, loss advices, and tax invoices retained for the statutory five-year record-keeping period.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) / Foreign-Currency Operational Account / VND Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB Bank)
Tien Phong Commercial Joint Stock Bank (TPBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / FX Hedging Counterparty Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low for use as a primary treasury account; Medium only as an ancillary FX/payment channel. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Revolut) are not licensed credit institutions in Viet Nam, cannot open VND-denominated accounts, and cannot clear VND payments through the SBV or the National Payment Corporation of Vietnam (NAPAS). The SBV does not recognize offshore EMI licenses for deposit-taking or local payment intermediation; cross-border transfers originating from such EMIs may be rejected by correspondent banks absent a clear underlying trade/reinsurance document trail. The captive reinsurance SPV must therefore maintain its principal account at an SBV-licensed commercial bank and use any EMI only for peripheral USD/EUR collections, with full reconciliation into the licensed-bank records and compliance with SBV reporting obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory. Vietnamese commercial banks require at least one legal representative, or a duly authorized signatory holding a notarized Vietnamese-language power of attorney, to appear in person at the branch for the AML/KYC interview and original-document verification. Remote or fully digital corporate onboarding is not generally permitted for a foreign-invested captive reinsurance SPV under current SBV and banking guidance. Overseas-appointed directors may sign the account-opening board resolution and banking mandate, but a locally resident legal representative or a local financial officer bearing a notarized power of attorney must attend the interview; every signatory on the mandate must individually complete identity verification, beneficial-ownership disclosure, and source-of-wealth confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore SPV with minimal local substance and no employees at the address of the registered office (a classic captive-insurance red flag).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), certified board resolution appointing the local legal representative, executed lease agreement for the registered office, staffing contracts or outsourced management/service agreement with an established insurance manager, group organizational chart, and a detailed statement of business purpose confirming captive reinsurance operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound premium wires from affiliated group companies that are inconsistent with the declared reinsurance portfolio in amount, frequency, or counterparty jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed reinsurance treaty and facultative certificates, premium bordereaux, actuarial underwriting memorandum, cedant-by-cedant exposure schedule, board-approved treasury policy, and bank-comfort source-of-funds letters from the cedants' remitting institutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment flows referencing, or counterparties resident in, high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions without an adequate sanctions-screening rationale for a reinsurance exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and PEP screening results, restrictive-endorsement analysis prepared by the compliance officer, underlying loss advices and claims documentation proving the commercial substance of each payment, and, if any sanctioned-party touch-point is identified, a formal SBV and OFAC-compliant license or negative screening certificate before any transaction is executed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the registered business scope (captive reinsurance) and large single-client flows that resemble treaty or third-party fronting rather than group-affiliate risk assumption.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Actuarial feasibility study for the captive, solvency-reserve computation, Ministry of Finance (MOF) confirmation or insurance/reinsurance license or exemption letter, certificate from the captive manager detailing the risk retention and retrocession programme, and audited financial statements showing technical reserves and claims development for the relevant underwriting year.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocols require all inbound equity injections to be remitted via SWIFT MT103 from the non-resident shareholder's account into the SPV's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) held at an SBV-licensed bank. The SWIFT remittance purpose/field 70 must expressly reference an FDI equity contribution ('gop von dau tu truc tiep') and the IRC registration number; the receiving bank posts the inflow to the registered legal-capital schedule and submits the transaction to the SBV balance-of-payments statistical reporting module. Shareholder loans must be wired into a separate SBV-registered loan account under a loan agreement filed with the SBV; equity injections and shareholder-subordinated loans must never be co-mingled in a single SWIFT. On high-value credit, the bank may request a source-of-funds confirmation (board resolution, shareholder financial statements, and recent bank statement) before the credit is made available.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound clearing rails: (i) reinsurance claim payments, retrocession premiums, and brokerage fees settled by SWIFT MT103/MT202 to overseas beneficiaries; (ii) collateral posting for reinsurance letters of credit executed through SWIFT MT760/MT799 (standby LC issuance) or MT700-series where a commercial/standby LC is used as settlement collateral; (iii) domestic VND obligations—taxes, statutory fees, payroll, and local service charges—settled through the NAPAS ACH system or the State Treasury collection platform. Each outbound payment must be supported by a board-approved claim bordereau, loss advices, reinsurance contract extracts, and tax invoices; VND conversion for any foreign-currency mismatch must be executed according to SBV day-to-day FX regulations at the licensed bank's published rate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore VND/USD FX forward contracts and FX swaps with SBV-licensed commercial banks, strictly limited to documented underlying commercial exposures arising from reinsurance premium and claim flows.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for USD-denominated shareholder loans that have been registered with the State Bank of Vietnam, used to align the funding currency with VND operational cash flows.
Short-term FX swaps between the DICA and the VND operational account for liquidity bridging, subject to the licensed bank's internal credit limits and SBV transaction reporting.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permitted as an onshore regulatory hedge; the SPV must use deliverable onshore forwards only, and any NDF-like arrangement would be treated as an unlicensed cross-border capital-account instrument in violation of SBV Circular No. 02/2015/TT-NHNN.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax finalization return (quyết toán thuế thu nhập doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Tax Department under General Department of Taxation, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from fiscal year-end (31 March for a calendar-year taxpayer)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing administrative fine up to VND 25,000,000; late payment interest 0.03% per day; continued delinquency may trigger enforced tax collection and cancellation of business registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements (báo cáo tài chính năm đã kiểm toán)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance - Insurance Supervisory Authority and local tax department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from fiscal year-end; must be submitted with the CIT finalization return and within insurance-reporting circular deadlines
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to VND 50,000,000 for non-submission or false statements; insurance-reporting violations may trigger special inspection, license suspension, or revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual enterprise license fee (lệ phí môn bài) payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest 0.03% per day plus administrative fines; persistent non-payment may lead to forced collection and cancellation of business registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual solvency and regulatory report of captive reinsurance operation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Insurance Supervisory Authority, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from fiscal year-end; specific insurance reporting circulars may impose earlier or additional deadlines
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to VND 80,000,000; non-compliance may result in special supervision, license renewal denial, or revocation of captive reinsurance authorization.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office under the Department of Planning and Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the annual tax finalization deadline, or immediately upon any change in registration details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to VND 50,000,000 for inaccurate or incomplete declaration; persistent failure may cause administrative dissolution or revocation of enterprise registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all insurance and reinsurance enterprises, including captive reinsurance SPVs, regardless of revenue or asset thresholds. Foreign-invested LLCs are also compulsory-audit entities even where no insurance license is held.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS), supplemented by Ministry of Finance insurance/accounting circulars; IFRS permitted for separate statutory accounts only on a consolidated voluntary adoption basis according to government pilot regulations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not maintain a standalone annual UBO filing regime. Any change in members, ownership shares, or ultimate beneficial ownership must be registered with the Business Registration Office within 10 days. Annually, the compliance officer must review and update the UBO record to comply with the AML Law, though no government filing is separately required.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT rate is 20%. Small and medium enterprises may benefit from reduced rates (15-17%) under certain conditions. High-tech, software, and eligible manufacturing projects may access incentives: 10% for 15 years, 4-year exemption + 50% reduction for 9 years, or other sector/regional incentives. Captive reinsurance SPVs typically do not qualify for manufacturing tax holidays unless registered under an eligible investment incentive scheme. Preferential rates and exemptions require advance approval by competent tax authorities and application of the Law on Enterprise Income Tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02/TNDN (Declaration of Corporate Income Tax) for quarterly provisional filings and final annual return Form 03/TNDN; electronic filing via the General Department of Taxation's e-Tax portal (https://etax.gdt.gov.vn) or the National Public Service Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual with quarterly provisional declarations (Form 02/TNDN) and final settlement return (Form 03/TNDN) at year-end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual final CIT return (Form 03/TNDN) must be submitted no later than the 90th day from the end of the fiscal year. Quarterly provisional CIT declarations must be filed within 30 days from the end of each quarter. Any tax payable difference must be settled by the deadline; overpayments may be offset or refunded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer name, tax identification number (TIN), fiscal year, address, and authorized signatory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Vietnamese TIN of the foreign-invested LLC; verify the registered address with the Department of Planning and Investment. A Vietnamese legal representative must confirm.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from business activities, including reinsurance premiums, investment income, and other income, computed per Vietnamese accounting standards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare all worldwide-source income attributable to the Vietnamese permanent establishment (the LLC). For offshore reinsurance transactions, ensure full recognition of premium income net of cancellations and ceding commissions as allowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business expenses directly attributable to generating revenue; capped per Law on Enterprise Income Tax (e.g., non-deductible provisions, entertainment cap of VND 1 million per receipt, and transfer pricing adjustment).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct expenses supported by contracts, invoices, and payment evidence. Reinsurance claims and technical reserves must meet insurance law recognition criteria; general provisions to captive reserves may be non-deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income exempt from CIT, including certain capital transfers, government bond interest, and benefits under investment incentives.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only if explicitly provided in law and evidenced by incentive certificates or licenses; otherwise leave nil.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of previously approved tax losses carried forward within 5 years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses reported and accepted in prior final returns may be carried. Carryforward cannot exceed 5 consecutive years from the year of loss.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisional quarterly payments totaling at least 80% of final annual liability; final payable is assessed in Form 03/TNDN.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure quarterly installments are sufficient to avoid interest charges on underpayment. Reconcile transfer pricing adjustments that increase taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction disclosure and TP adjustment schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete all fields for captive reinsurance premiums ceded to or received from foreign group entities. Disclose intercompany pricing methodology and economic analysis to support arm's length results.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for foreign income tax paid on foreign-source income included in Vietnamese CIT base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only with proof of foreign tax payment (TRC or official receipt) and country-by-country (CbC) coordination. Credit limited to Vietnamese CIT payable on that foreign income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: Pending late-filing fine from VND 4,000,000 up to VND 20,000,000 depending on delay; additional penalty of 0.03%/day on late payment amount. Underpayment from fraudulent declaration: 20% penalty on under-declared tax plus late payment interest. Failure to file: criminal prosecution engaging article 200/201 of the Penal Code if tax evasion threshold met.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends distributed by an LLC to its corporate non-resident shareholders (subject to profit remittance tax).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Non-resident corporate shareholders receiving dividends from Vietnam must apply the profit remittance tax (10% default on distributed profits, unless reduced under an applicable DTA). To invoke treaty relief: (1) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the shareholder's home tax authority; (2) submit TRC, audited financial statements, minutes of the profit distribution meeting, and a cover letter to the Vietnamese tax officer before remittance; (3) tax office issues an approval of reduced rate or exemption; (4) remit profits via a licensed bank after settling the tax. Without advance treaty approval, pay the 10% statutory rate and claim refund through a subsequent administrative process.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on royalties and interest paid to non-residents is 5% for interest and 10% for royalties under the Law on Enterprise Income Tax and withholding tax regulations. DTA rates vary: interest often 10% (or 5% for financial institutions under certain treaties); royalties often 5-10% depending on the DTA. Effective from treaty application, a TRC and documentation are required to apply reduced rates.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File / Master File if total related-party transactions exceed VND 50 billion (~USD 2.1 million) per fiscal year, or total revenue exceeds VND 200 billion (~USD 8.5 million), or total assets exceed VND 50 billion; entities below thresholds must still keep contemporaneous TP documentation if a related-party transaction exists and the tax authority requests for benchmarking.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: General anti-avoidance rules under the Tax Administration Law apply; Vietnam does not maintain formal Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) as in UAE/BCI. However, a captive reinsurance entity must be commercially rational, have actual decision-making and risk-bearing people in Vietnam, and not be a conduit entity. Face-to-face control, adequate capital, and actual underwriting activity are required; failure will trigger recharacterization, or denial of TP concessions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underpricing reinsurance premiums ceded to the captive SPV or offshore parent, failure to apply arm's length method, submitting TD documentation with misleading comparables, or not disclosing related-party transactions in the CIT return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority has the power to adjust taxable income, deny TP benefits, impose 20% penalty on under-declared tax, plus late-payment interest at 0.03%/day. Failure to maintain documentation may lead to administrative fines up to VND 50 million and subsequently tax adjustments based on the authority's own determination.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be responsible for false declarations if they sign incorrect tax returns; criminal liability from deliberate tax evasion can reach imprisonment up to 7 years. Civil restitution of unpaid taxes and interest may be enforced against personal assets of the legal representative if the company is dissolved without settlement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Vietnam captive insurer has no real office, no employees, no board meetings in Vietnam, contracts and books held abroad, and operates as a pure booking conduit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authorities may disregard the entity for tax purposes (substance-over-form) or recharacterize transactions; addition of tax and penalties as above. Insurance regulator may revoke license, impose administrative fines up to VND 1 billion, or order shutdown for operating without a valid license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Registered legal representative's personal civil liability arises for unlawful management; foreign directors can be subject to travel bans if assets are not remitted to settle tax arrears, and possible criminal prosecution for insurance business fraud or tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Making/receiving reinsurance settlement payments in violation of foreign-exchange regulations, failing to report cross-border wire transfers to the State Bank of Vietnam, or poor record-keeping of beneficial owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML fines up to VND 500 million for violations; criminal charges for laundering proceeds of crime up to 15 years imprisonment. Foreign-exchange control violations carry fines of up to VND 400 million; banking account freezes and license suspension possible.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Direct scans may be criminally liable for money laundering if knowingly involved; travel bans and asset attachment are common pre-trial measures; personal accountability for restitution in civil actions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Transferring profits, royalties, or interest to foreign shareholders without withholding DTA tax, submitting fake TRC for treaty relief, or mischaracterizing dividends as loan repayment or service fee to avoid 10% profit remittance tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: 20% penalty on under-withheld tax, plus interest; fine up to VND 200 million, criminal prosecution for tax evasion if over VND 100 million unpaid.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize unlawful distributions without tax clearance become personally liable for the unpaid WHT; criminal sanctions including imprisonment up to 5 years under the Penal Code.
